info.one_liner: A free editor that fixes the text in a PDF right where it is, inside your browser
info.audience: People who now and then need to fix a contract, form or other PDF
info.problem: Installing software just to fix one word in a PDF, or uploading a document with personal data to a site you have never used
info.how: The PDF engine runs inside your browser, so your file is never uploaded to a server
facts: Files are processed only inside your browser and are never uploaded to a server
Works in desktop (PC, Mac) and mobile browsers
limits: I am building it solo, so there are still rough edges
stories: I wanted to fix one amount in a contract PDF and was told to install software first, so I decided to build my own
I tried several PDF editing sites, but many switched to paid after a few uses or were paid from the start, so I just built my own

features.name: Edit text
features.desc: Tap a line in the PDF and change the text right there. Edits match the original font, weight and spacing

features.name: Find and redact personal data
features.desc: Automatically finds phone numbers, ID numbers, emails, card numbers and account-like numbers and redacts them in one go. Redacted text is actually removed when you save

features.name: Add a signature
features.desc: Draw your signature or type your name to make one and place it on the PDF. Signatures are saved only in your browser

features.name: Merge and split
features.desc: Combine several PDFs into one, pull out the pages you need, or split a PDF into several files

features.name: Compress
features.desc: Shrinks the images inside a PDF to make the file smaller

updates.note: Added page numbers. You can choose the position and the starting number
Fixed a bug where edited lines came out with wider letter spacing than the original
